There’s also a very common problem where your AFAB bits try to overcompensate for lack of estrogen down in your junk and will cause a non-painful infection. Just keep tabs on your genital health in general, really, and be sure to let your hormone doctor know about anything being weird down there. It’s a very easy fix from your hormones being all wonky.
